messages.author: 1e1f6c27d3c442a5
messages.subject: [Shiny-server-pro] "Websocket closed" when HTTP, not HTTPS
parts:
Hi,
I use a corporate proxy which seems to badly interact with shiny/websockets.

I got this error in chrome console:
shiny-server-client.min.js:1 Mon Nov 21 2016 16:25:12 GMT+0100 (CET) [INF]: Error: WebSocket closed
shiny-server-client.min.js:1 Mon Nov 21 2016 16:25:12 GMT+0100 (CET) [INF]: Connection closed. Info: {"isTrusted":false}
shiny-server-client.min.js:1 Mon Nov 21 2016 16:25:12 GMT+0100 (CET) [DBG]: SockJS connection closed
shiny-server-client.min.js:1 Mon Nov 21 2016 16:25:12 GMT+0100 (CET) [DBG]: Channel 0 is closed
shiny-server-client.min.js:1 Mon Nov 21 2016 16:25:12 GMT+0100 (CET) [DBG]: Removed channel 0, 0 left

and a grey screen with part of the UI not painted, when using my app in HTTP.
While using the same app in HTTPS (through shiny server pro) does not crash anymore.

Note that I use a very basic app for testing (the simple histogram example on main shiny page).
my shiny-server.conf (which includes a "disable_protocols websocket", strangely not taken into account):

$ more shiny-server.conf
# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "shiny"
run_as shiny;

google_analytics_id UA-XXXXXXX;
directory_index off;
disable_protocols websocket xdr-polling;
app_init_timeout 120;
app_idle_timeout 20;

server {
  listen 80;

  log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location /app {
    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    #site_dir /srv/shiny-server;
    site_dir /home/ubuntu/app;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server_app;
  }
}

server {
  listen 443;
  ssl /home/ubuntu/my.key /home/ubuntu/my.crt;

  log_dir /var/log/shiny-server;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location /app {
    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    #site_dir /srv/shiny-server;
    site_dir /home/ubuntu/app;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory
    log_dir /var/log/shiny-server_app;
  }
}

Thanks !

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [Shiny-server-pro] "Websocket closed" when HTTP, not HTTPS
parts:
In case it's not clear, you can disable these protocols on the server side in your /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf, so they're never served. http://docs.rstudio.com/shiny-server/#disabling-websockets-on-the-server

However, that's a pretty harsh proxy configuration you have there. If it's possible I'd try to use https instead, especially since you can get free certificates now from https://letsencrypt.org/.
